description: Run the initial AI takeoff for a new project whose plan PDF was attached with attach_plan_pdf or uploaded by the user on the project page in Portravo. Consumes one estimate credit from the user's existing Portravo balance; the call is refused unless confirm_credit_use is true. Repeating a call with the same idempotency_key does not charge again. Returns extracted quantities for review in Portravo, not a bid-ready estimate. Failed provider runs refund the reservation; existing review work cannot be overwritten.
name: run_takeoff
title: Extract a construction plan takeoff
